primer: Divi's Laboratories Ltd (DIVISLAB) is India's premier debt-free API and Custom Synthesis compounder, valued at ~₹2,94,140 Cr at the verified ₹11,080.00 NSE close (₹11,150.00 / ₹2,95,997 Cr in the TradingView/Screener snapshot) [1][19]. Across our price-blind audit, the franchise earned COMPOUNDER_PASS on 22.0% ROCE, 96.7% 12-year cash conversion, and a 43% Q2 FY27 margin [1][10]. Yet even on a 65x FY28E PAT (₹5,100 Cr / ₹192.1 EPS) Base target of ₹12,500, support-zone asymmetry at ₹10,638 vs. the ₹8,118 stop is only 0.74:1 (< 1.50:1 hurdle) [1][23]. Under our Anti-Hedging Rule, we rate DIVISLAB REJECTED (VALUATION) — great business, wrong price.
holding_rationale: DIVISLAB is NOT_HELD in the live Indian portfolio as of 2026-11-16 (0 shares held; 0 shares to sell). Business quality passes with COMPOUNDER_PASS and Stage 2 leadership remains intact (+14.86% above 10W EMA ₹9,646.12; +15.12% above 50D SMA ₹9,624.60). However, anchoring Base target to 65x FY28E PAT (₹5,100 Cr) yields ₹12,500—only 0.48:1 R:R at CMP (₹11,080.00) and 0.74:1 at the ₹10,638 support top vs. the ₹8,118 stop (< 1.50:1). Under the Anti-Hedging Rule, new capital is REJECTED on VALUATION (NOT_OPTIONABLE_OR_ILLIQUID).

destinations.entry_condition: Re-underwrite only on a deeper valuation reset (<= ₹9,500) or an upward FY28E PAT revision above ₹5,600 Cr that restores >= 1.50:1 asymmetry.
